> An API is refusing your request for a commercial reason rather than a technical one: a failed payment, an exhausted quota, an expired trial, or a feature…

Read the response body, since services that send 402 usually explain which limit you hit. Do not retry, because the same request will fail identically until the billing condition changes. And if a 402 appears in production, route the alert to whoever can authorise payment rather than to engineering.
